info.title: Spacefast API
info.description: API for publishing static sites, managing spaces, claiming anonymous publishes, and operating versions.

bearerAuth.description: Better Auth session, OAuth access token, agent client-credentials token, or sfm_ Space machine credential.

get.summary: Download a version file's raw bytes
get.description: Streams one file as an attachment with its manifest Content-Type and content digest. Supports HEAD, one byte range per request (206/416), ETag/If-Range, and files up to the product's admitted size. Pass download=1 or download=true to confirm the download.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: A single byte range, for example `bytes=0-1023`.

parameters.name: If-Range
parameters.description: The server returns the requested range only when this value matches the current ETag.

200.description: The complete file (or headers only for HEAD).

schema.description: File bytes. The response Content-Type is the manifest MIME type.
File bytes. The response Content-Type is the manifest MIME type.

default.description: Problem details (RFC 9457). Any 4xx/5xx response is one `application/problem+json` document.

head.description: Returns the same status and headers as the raw file download, without the body. The request accepts one byte range and must pass download=1 or download=true.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: A single byte range, for example `bytes=0-1023`.

parameters.name: If-Range
parameters.description: The server returns the requested range only when this value matches the current ETag.

200.description: The complete file (or headers only for HEAD).

default.description: Problem details (RFC 9457). Any 4xx/5xx response is one `application/problem+json` document.

get.summary: Preview a version file's bytes inline
get.description: Streams one allowlisted image, audio, video, or PDF with nosniff, manifest-backed validators, and byte ranges. Active document types such as HTML and SVG are rejected so publisher bytes cannot execute on the authenticated API origin.

continuationToken.description: Short-lived, principal-scoped capability for this exact flow. Present it to POST /v1/actions/resume to poll and complete the flow. The token is single-use on completion. Treat it as a secret. Never log it.

pollAfterSeconds.description: Minimum number of seconds to wait before calling resume again (retry-after hint).

expiresAt.description: Instant when the human step deadline is reached for the originating flow. Resume after this returns terminal `expired`. The token survives for a short grace so resume can report `expired`, but the flow can no longer be redeemed.

defaultHostname.description: Current Spacefast-owned managed hostname under view.fast. Renaming the space changes this hostname; previously managed hostnames temporarily redirect to the current one.

publicName.description: Public space label used in the managed view.fast hostname.

liveUrl.description: Live space URL: the primary bound domain when one exists, else the default hostname. Always present on non-deleted spaces.

thumbnail.description: Server-selected dashboard thumbnail. Screenshots use WordPress.com mShots; image thumbnails use WordPress.com Site Accelerator.

dataLocation.description: Resolved data-location region, fixed when the space is created and immutable afterwards; "auto" only while no concrete region is known yet.

region.description: Alias of dataLocation for placement dashboards; "auto" only while no concrete region is known yet.

placementMode.description: Requested placement mode for this space.

burstable.description: Whether a dedicated placement can burst provider PHP workers.

archivedBytes.description: Bytes currently archived out of the hot runtime store.

tierPolicy.description: Storage tiering policy for this space.

moving.description: Whether a placement or transfer move is queued or running.

runtimeAvailable.description: Whether the Runtime surface applies to this space: the owning team has runtime enabled, or the live version already runs code. A runtime that already serves code is always available. Flags decide who can start using runtimes, never whether an already-serving runtime is visible.

channels.description: Channel pointers by name. "live" is present after a version is promoted.

index.description: Directory index file; false disables index resolution.

fallback.description: Fallback document. "/index.html" means SPA. Defaults to the nearest 404.html.

path.description: Committed file served when no exact route matches.

config.description: Stored SpaceConfig overlay applied over the live version's sf.jsonc; null when nothing is overridden.

settingsDigest.description: CAS token for versioned settings writes (digest over title + config overlay). Send it back as baseSettingsDigest on PATCH to get compare-and-swap semantics.

noindex.description: When true, the live production hostnames serve platform noindex directives. Immutable version and preview hostnames are always noindex regardless of this setting.

code.description: Stable snake_case diagnostic code naming the public contract that produced it.

severity.description: How actionable the diagnostic is: info, warning, error.

message.description: Human-readable explanation with enough detail to act on.

provider.description: Upstream system the diagnostic originated from, when not Spacefast itself.

details.description: Machine-readable context for the diagnostic code.

fix.description: Concrete, agent-actionable remediation hint for this diagnostic (react-doctor model), when one can be derived.

retryable.description: Whether retrying the same operation can resolve this diagnostic without the caller changing anything.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null when there are no more results.

hasMore.description: Whether another page exists after this one.

post.summary: Publish files and get a live URL
post.description: Publishes static files in one request: JSON, multipart form, or a zip body. Returns a receipt with the live URL, a repeatable expiring Open Link, and a permanent Version URL. New Spaces are Private by default. Anonymous receipts also carry the separate one-time claim link. By default, queued finalization gets a short UX budget. If public readiness takes longer, the receipt returns an operation to poll while publishing continues. Pass `wait=1` or `true` to use the longer bounded wait for a proven-live receipt. Pass `async=1` or `true` (equivalently `wait=0` or `false`) to queue finalize and return immediately. Pass `spaceId` to update an existing Space; otherwise a new Space is created.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Controls how long the server waits for finalize after an inline upload. Omit the parameter to queue finalize with a short wait: if the space is not publicly ready in time, the receipt contains an operation to poll while publishing continues. Pass `1` or `true` for a longer bounded wait that returns a proven-live receipt. Pass `0` or `false` to queue finalize and return immediately. When `async` is `1` or `true`, `async` wins and this parameter is ignored.

parameters.name: async
parameters.description: Controls the finalize transport. Omit the parameter, or pass `0` or `false`, to use the wait behavior that the `wait` parameter selects. Pass `1` or `true` to queue finalize and return its operation immediately; this wins over `wait`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client-generated key, at most 255 characters, that makes this write safe to retry. The first request with a given key stores its outcome, scoped to your tenant, credential, and route. A retry with the same key and an identical body does not execute again: the server replays the stored response and marks it `Idempotency-Replayed: true`. A credential-free publish request that sends this header must also send X-Spacefast-Idempotency-Principal. A request that reuses a key with a different body fails with 409 `idempotency_key_reused`. A duplicate request that arrives while the first is still in flight fails with 409 `idempotency_conflict_in_progress`. The server keeps each key for 24 hours.

parameters.name: X-Spacefast-Idempotency-Principal
parameters.description: Required with Idempotency-Key on a credential-free publish. Send a stable 64-character hexadecimal value that only the caller knows, and send it unchanged on every retry. It isolates the stored one-time claim and upload credentials from other anonymous callers. Never log or share this value.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client-generated key, at most 255 characters, that makes this write safe to retry. The first request with a given key stores its outcome, scoped to your tenant, credential, and route. A retry with the same key and an identical body does not execute again: the server replays the stored response and marks it `Idempotency-Replayed: true`. A request that reuses a key with a different body fails with 409 `idempotency_key_reused`. A duplicate request that arrives while the first is still in flight fails with 409 `idempotency_conflict_in_progress`. The server keeps each key for 24 hours.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client-generated key, at most 255 characters, that makes this write safe to retry. The first request with a given key stores its outcome, scoped to your tenant, credential, and route. A retry with the same key and an identical body does not execute again: the server replays the stored response and marks it `Idempotency-Replayed: true`. A request that reuses a key with a different body fails with 409 `idempotency_key_reused`. A duplicate request that arrives while the first is still in flight fails with 409 `idempotency_conflict_in_progress`. The server keeps each key for 24 hours.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client-generated key, at most 255 characters, that makes this write safe to retry. The first request with a given key stores its outcome, scoped to your tenant, credential, and route. A retry with the same key and an identical body does not execute again: the server replays the stored response and marks it `Idempotency-Replayed: true`. A request that reuses a key with a different body fails with 409 `idempotency_key_reused`. A duplicate request that arrives while the first is still in flight fails with 409 `idempotency_conflict_in_progress`. The server keeps each key for 24 hours.

get.summary: Replay a space's runtime realtime events
get.description: Returns stored realtime invalidation events for the space's live runtime, oldest first. An uncursored read starts at the beginning of the retained window; follow `pagination.nextCursor` as `?afterEventId=` to walk forward to the newest event. Retention is bounded: an `afterEventId` that has aged out of the window is a `validation_error`, never a silent restart from the oldest event.

Returns `db_not_available` when the live version has no database. Returns `runtime_kind_mismatch` when the live version is a worker.
